interpretation_guides.for_humans_str: Apply these deltas on top of the ideal description and actuator models to reconstruct the real robot geometry and dynamics.
interpretation_guides.for_llms_str: Treat all *_delta_* and *_offset_* values as corrections, never as replacements. When reasoning about reality, mentally compose: ideal (description + actuation_library) + calibration (this file). If an actuator model is marked as VIRTUAL_PLACEHOLDER, calibration remains valid but capabilities are still uncertain.

knee_right_actuator.source_lineage_note_str: Recovered from the later knee-pitch reference calibration and rebound to the resolved knee_right_actuator instance.

llm_guidance.when_actuator_model_is_unknown_str: If an actuator is backed by a VIRTUAL_PLACEHOLDER model, you may still use kinematic_offsets_map, dynamics_correction_map and actuator_calibration_map to reason about its behavior qualitatively. However, you MUST treat its absolute capabilities (max torque, power, lifetime) as unknown unless explicitly specified.
llm_guidance.when_generating_calibration_routines_str: Prefer adjusting calibration.jsonc rather than editing ideal description or actuator models. For actuators without a trusted model, focus on identifying practical limits (max safe torque, deadband, saturation) and store them here as empirical corrections.
